name: Technologies in Agriculture Value Chains: Linking Rural Development and Global Trade
description: This course explores the intersection of agricultural value chains, rural development, and global trade, with a focus on India’s evolving agri-food systems. Students will study the structure and function of value chains, the role of rural actors and FPOs, trade agreements, regulatory bodies, and sustainability standards. Emphasis is placed on moderate technological interventions—such as ICT, blockchain, traceability tools, and AI for enhancing efficiency and compliance. Through case studies and reports analysis, the course equips students to critically engage with global agri-trade, MRL regulations, and export readiness, while designing inclusive, resilient, and market-linked value chain solutions for rural development.
